articleTitle: Scalable Service Oriented V2X Data Format over 5G-NR-V2X
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: This article provides a description of the Scalable Service Oriented V2X (SSOV) Data Format implemented within the context of the 5G-NR-V2X framework. In this study, we introduce a novel system designed to facilitate the development and assessment of self-driving services. The system leverages On-Board Units (OBU) and Roadside Units (RSU) for 5G-NR-V2X communication, specifically targeting vehicles operating at level 4 autonomy or higher. The system aims to provide ultra-high-speed communication, with a minimum data rate of 150Mbps, as well as ultra-low latency, ensuring a delay of 3ms or less. Additionally, the system prioritizes high reliability, aiming for a communication robustness satisfaction level of 99.99 percent, even under malicious conditions. Various applications are employed to achieve these objectives. The proposed SSOV data format outlined in this study is expected to facilitate the advancement of ultrafast, ultralow-delay, and high-confidence V2X communication technologies. Furthermore, it is anticipated that the services verified by the proposed data format will augment technical competitiveness within the domains of road infrastructure, transportation systems, logistical operations, and commercial enterprises.

articleTitle: Automatic Reverse Parking Algorithm for Inter-Vehicle Spaces Using Rear 2D Lidar
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: This paper presents an automatic reverse parking algorithm utilizing a rear 2D lidar sensor, aimed at achieving precise parking between two vehicles. The algorithm leverages the angle bisector of the sector formed by the two vehicles and employs distance measurements from the lidar to optimize parking accuracy. The proposed approach focuses on the algorithmic aspects post-space detection, emphasizing the real-time coordination of steering and speed control. The experimental results demonstrate consistent success across multiple trials, showcasing the algorithm's ability to achieve collision-free and accurate parking between vehicles. This research contributes to the advancement of autonomous parking technology, particularly in scenarios involving constrained parking spaces.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Impact of ECU Synchronization on the SOME/IP Service Discovery
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: As advanced technologies for driver convenience develop day by day, vehicle systems continue to become complicated. Also, the amount of data to be processed in the vehicle network is increasing. In this situation, there is a need for a service-oriented architecture that can effectively manage the software platform. SOME/IP is Ethernet-based middleware and is attracting attention as a means of implementing a service-oriented architecture. However, some problems have not yet been solved to be actively applied to vehicle systems. This paper aims to deal with the subscription latency problem in the SOME/IP service discovery process. We analyze the effect of jitter on startup behavior and show how much the subscription latency improves when ECU time synchronization is applied.

articleTitle: Real-time Steering Control algorithm based on Lane Segmentation image using Monocular view for Map-less Driving
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Growing interest in integrating in-vehicle data processing and artificial intelligence (AI) has significantly improved performance. This improvement extends to technologies like object detection, with rapid progress, and pixel-based segmentation research in various directions. While research on steering value processing using AI models is ongoing, model-centric studies continue to garner attention. This paper discusses a framework for obtaining lane gradients using instance segmentation techniques among segmentation methods. It emphasizes the development of image processing independent of control systems or single-model limitations, proposes a service-oriented methodology for better management and development, and outlines the utilization of pre-trained instance segmentation models.

articleTitle: Smart Factory Mold Injection Anomaly Detection Using Deep Autoencoder Neural network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: The swift progression of Industry 4.0 has given rise to smart factories, which employ sophisticated technologies to enhance operational efficiency. Nevertheless, the intricate and expansive nature of contemporary manufacturing systems presents difficulties in promptly recognizing and managing unusual occurrences. This research suggests a method for detecting anomalies in smart factories by employing a Deep Autoencoder Neural Network. This network is supplemented by subsequent processing stages that refine the residual image, thereby enhancing the accuracy of anomaly detection. The Autoencoder is a deep learning model that learns to rebuild input data and is particularly well-suited for anomaly detection applications.

articleTitle: Device identification in BLE packets from moving devices with randomized MAC addresses
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: In recent years, IoT devices and smartphones that communicate with low power consumption Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) have become widespread. In such devices, since MAC addresses are often randomized at an interval, it is difficult to identify the same device from packets observed over a period of time. In this paper, we propose a method for estimating the same device in an environment where device moves. As a result of the evaluation, we confirmed that our proposed method can identify a device with an accuracy of up to 94 % when the number of devices is 20.

articleTitle: Versatile-VTON: A Versatile Virtual Try-on Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Virtual Try-on Network, an AI technology for virtual clothing try-ons in online stores, offers users an intuitive experience with lucrative commercial potential. Most of VTON researches have focused on single garments, and have limitation in application to trying on various types of clothing. This is an inevitable issue due to limited provision of only top images in the dataset. Although recent datasets used in VTON include various types of clothing images and labels, including tops, bottoms, and dresses, it is not sufficient to give usability of virtual try-on of clothing items other than tops compared to the available data. We introduce Versatile-VTON to give more usability and better quality of VTON. Also, we show the feasibility of the proposed method by presenting quantitative measurements and conducting ablation study experiments.

articleTitle: Automatic Segmentation Labeling for Autonomous Driving Datasets
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: In this paper, we propose an algorithm that automatically labels datasets for the development and testing of autonomous vehicles. Traditionally, it is commonly used hand-labeled datasets, which is costly and time-consuming. In this work, we address these problems by automatically labeling based on YOLOPv2 model and validate it on an autonomous driving algorithm.

articleTitle: Radian Scaling: A Novel Approach to Preventing Concept Drift in Electricity Load Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Artificial neural networks often suffer from concept drift when predicting the electricity load in smart cities due to seasonal trends. The most commonly used methods to solve this issue are automatically updating the model, using feature engineering to capture the seasonality trends, and using ensemble methods, making the model complex for someone to replicate. Furthermore, as the issue is mostly due to the shifted minimum and maximum values, we need a method to normalize without being bound by the training data's scale, mean, and median. We proposed radian scaling to normalize the angles between the two consecutive values for the artificial neural networks to process. Our prediction result shows high accuracy with a root-mean-square error score of 0.0021 and 0.0036 for many-to-one and many-to-many forecasting scenarios, surpassing existing methods without model modification.

articleTitle: Enhancement of Dynamic Output Timing Control of Fragrance in Metaverse
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: In this paper, we enhance the dynamic output timing control of fragrance to extend its application to metaverse. This control dynamically adjusts the timing of fragrance output based on the video's playback speed (i.e., movement speed of user) and positions of fragrance sources. We also carry out QoE (Quality of Experiment) to clarify the parameters for the enhanced control.

articleTitle: A Multimodal Transfer Learning Approach for Medical Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: In machine learning for healthcare, medical image data often suffers from data scarcity and expensive annotation processes. In this study, to develop a robust medical image classification model, we propose a novel approach that leverages the multimodal pre-trained PubMedCLIP model as a backbone. Through experiments, we demonstrate that this straightforward approach offers substantial benefits in image classification task, reducing annotation costs while maintaining performance. By leveraging multimodal information and the power of pre-trained models, our method provides a promising solution to address the challenges posed by limited medical image data, enabling more efficient and accurate image classification.

articleTitle: A Low-Latency and Lightweight FPGA-Based Engine for Softmax and Layer Normalization Acceleration
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Vector operations such as GELU, softmax, and layer normalization are essential for transformers, but generally consume long latency on general-purpose CPU and GPU due to their low arithmetic intensities and high nonlinearity. In this study, we propose a low-latency FPGA-based architecture for accelerating the vector operations. Specifically, the proposed design includes processing elements for micro-instructions and a controller that decomposes and executes vector operations into in-order low-level instructions effectively. Experiments show that an FPGA implementation of the proposed design achieves a latency of 1.31us for softmax and 3.76us for layer normalization, while consuming 385 DSPs, 16 BRAMs, 71k FFs, and 57k. LUTs.

articleTitle: Crop & Match: RoI Cropping and Feature Matching for Segmentation of Small Objects
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: In semantic segmentation, predicting RoI (Region of Interest) classes or objects within small regions faces challenges. To address this issue, we propose Crop&Match, a method to combine RoI cropping and feature matching, to enhance model performance of small RoI classes. The cropping ensures the network to focus on small RoI regions by cropping image regions to contain RoI. And feature matching aligns input images with their RoI cropped versions at a representation level, improving predictive consistency across different perspectives on the same image, thereby boosting RoI class recognition.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Load Regulation LDO with Ripple Cancellation for Clock Generator in 28nm CMOS
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: This paper presents a structure that effectively mitigates load ripples generated by a voltage-controlled oscillator (VCO) attached as a load to a low-dropout (LDO) regulator. This employs the suggested sub-pass transistor and reduced load capacitor. This method effectively reduces ripples while maintaining a steady power supply. Furthermore, by reducing the load capacitor within the LDO regulator, this design solves space constraints. The proposed structure is composed of the integration of the voltage controlled delay line (VCDL) and sub-pass transistors. The proposed LDO regulator is manufactured using 28nm CMOS technology and regulates a 1.2V supply to 1V. The measured improvement in terms of ripple reduction amounts to 46 %.

articleTitle: A Study of Exergame System Using Hand Gestures for Tenosynovitis Prevention
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: As more and more people have been addicted to cell phones, long-term use of fingers may cause tenosynovitis. Then, it becomes very important to prevent it by providing proper exercise opportunities to such people. To play video games using hand gestures, called exergame, will be a good candidate. In this paper, we study a simple exergame system on a PC under this motivation. We design three sets of hand gestures to control the key operations to play the adopted five games, and implement the recognition program in Python using Mediapipe. They have different levels of di culty for a player to perform. As the preliminary evaluation of the proposal, we asked three students in Okayama University, Japan, to play them by following the prepared manual, and to give comments and opinions on usability and effectiveness of the system.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis on Harmonic Characteristics of Traction Network for AC / DC locomotive
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: With the rapid development of China's high-speed and heavy-haul railways, the problem of power supply system in harmonic becomes more and more prominent, which reduces the efficiency and quality of power supply. In order to suppress harmonics, it is necessary to analyze the harmonic characteristics of the system. This design mainly analyzes the locomotive part in the system, and chooses SS4 type locomotive and CRH2 type locomotive as the research object. By constructing two kinds of locomotive running simulation model and mixed model, simulation analysis was carried out on the different stages of locomotive, get the net side current harmonic content and current distortion rate is analyzed, the research results show that the joint simulation model can accurately reflect the ac/dc locomotive run impact on the harmonic of traction network, for the power supply system harmonic governance and provide basis for the operation.

articleTitle: Research on Interactive Dataset for Transparent Display-Based Interactive Content Development
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Recent advancements in autonomous vehicles have led to a growing popularity of transparent displays. Transparent displays are ideal for augmented reality (AR) applications that overlay digital information onto the real world, offering an appealing user experience through touch, gestures, and other interactive methods. However, most existing transparent displays are limited to the role of one-way information delivery, failing to fully harness the advantages of transparent display technology. Research on interactive datasets for realistic content interaction with transparent displays, including hand gestures, gaze, voice, points of interest (POI), and touch, is currently underway, and this paper summarizes these aspects. With the development and proliferation of transparent display technology, it is essential to review research on applicable interactive dataset technology. While this paper does not cover all studies related to interactive datasets for transparent displays, it is expected to be valuable for researchers involved in such studies.

articleTitle: New Generation Encryption Chip Based on the GAN Chaos Model and the Geffe Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: In this paper, we proposed a new generation encryption chip based on the generative adversarial network (GAN) Chaos model and the Geffe architecture. Compared with software encryption, hardware encryption is not easy to be attacked, data and programs are mixed, and hardware cracking analysis is difficult. It can effectively avoid attacks such as reverse engineering and the calculation speed is faster. In order to perform more unpredictable hardware encryption, this study designs the GAN algorithm to generate encryption circuit, establishes the convolutional neural network (CNN) model through training, and combines the random number generator circuit of Geffe architecture to realize the system with digital integrated circuit. To reduce and improve the calculation speed, the iterative calculation method is used to design, which can reduce the circuit area, optimize memory consumption, improve the calculation speed of CNN, and achieve a faster AI encryption inference chip. The experimental results prove that our proposed method reduces the computing time by 78.4% and realizes a high-performance encryption chip.

articleTitle: Historical Asset Viewer for Efficient Management of Cultural Heritage
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: This paper is about a plan to expand the conservation management and customized utilization service of cultural heritage. There are various platforms for storing and managing digital data at the National Museum of Korea. However, as many platforms began to provide services tailored to their respective purposes, there was no platform that covered all stages from the excavation of cultural assets to exhibitions. In addition, there is no viewer within the platform that can check files such as images or PDF documents attached to Heritage, and it is cumbersome to download and check each file. Therefore, for efficient management, fragmented cultural heritage knowledge resources are digitized and integrated, and information centered on artifacts is provided at a glance through a cultural heritage-based historical asset viewer.

articleTitle: Lightweight Transit-time Ultrasonic Flow Measurement System using Relative Flow Difference Calculation Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: This study proposes a lightweight signal processing architecture that reduces the number of signal samplings and calculations to reduce the weight of the flow measurement system using ultrasonic signals. The proposed architecture is a flow measurement method using unidirectional sampling rather than bidirectional sampling to minimize ADC operation in a flow measurement system using bidirectional ultrasonic signals, and is intended to reduce the amount of computation in the time domain by applying a window to the signal for flow measurement. In order to minimize the amount of calculation, the flow measurement architecture is implemented using only specific parts of the ultrasonic signal rather than the entire ultrasonic signal. The proposed architecture is applied to ultrasonic signals obtained from an actual flow measurement system to confirm its operation and analyze its accuracy. As a result, it is analyzed that the measurement accuracy is still within the error range of the meter even though the number of sampling is reduced and the amount of calculation is reduced.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of Multiple Terminal Systems under Communication Delay by using Delayed Differential Equation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: The authors have studied a method for describing the behavior of haptic communication under communication delay by using difference differential equations and determining stability by the roots of the characteristic equation. This paper firstly introduces the outline of this method. Furthermore, we found that this method can be applied to determine the stability of consensus control of multiple terminals under communication delay or systems that simulate diffusion equations with a large number of communication nodes operating autonomously and decentralized. This paper reports the above results.

articleTitle: Improvements of Blank Element Selection Algorithm for Element Fill-in-blank Problem in Web-client Programming
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: In modern societies, web application systems take main roles among Internet-based information systems. To enhance educations of web-client programming for interactive user interfaces on browsers, we have studied the Element Fill-in-blank Problem (EFP) as a self-guided learning tool. EFP involves students completing the given source code based on the web page screenshots, fostering a dynamic approach to mastering web-client programming. Previously, the blank element selection algorithm has been studied to automatically generate EFP instances from source codes. However, the current algorithm encounters several limitations such as selections of meaningless blanks and insufficient selections of CSS properties. In this paper, we propose two improvements of this algorithm to address the limitations, namely, the two-step blank element identification and the key CSS property consideration. These improvements will help generate higher-quality EFP instances. As the evaluation of the proposal, we compared the outputs of the previous and proposed algorithms on the 10 source codes, and confirmed that the proposal could avoid meaningless blanks and increase the blanks for CSS properties.

articleTitle: Facial Video-based Remote Photoplethysmography Signal Estimation with Vision Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG), which is measured remotely with a video camera under ambient light conditions, is actively researched due to its accessibility and convenience. rPPG analysis can also estimate important biomarkers such as heart rate (HR) and heart rate variability (HRV). The majority of previous studies primarily designed algorithms to directly estimate HR or HRV. Instead, we note that regression analysis is used to recover the rPPG itself. This method has two benefits. Photoplethysmography (PPG) derived from a contact sensor provides crucial information for refining rPPG and insights for model development. Motivated by these considerations, we propose a model for end-to-end rPPG signal estimation. Vision transformer (ViT)-based model, which takes into account long-range correlations of rPPG, is adopted as the network's backbone, and the proposed model is evaluated using the MPSC-rPPG dataset.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on Implicit Neural Representation-based Arbitrary-Scale Image Super-Resolution
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Arbitrary-scale image super-resolution (ASISR) is one of the challenging tasks in computer vision due to its ill-posed nature. Recent works with implicit neural representation (INR) have shown a promising ability in representing images with arbitrary resolutions. In this paper, we compare and analyze different INR methods for ASISR.

articleTitle: Optimizing Deep Neural Network with Brain Floating Half-Precision Format
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Deep neural network (DNN) are becoming common in the industry due to their exceptional performance. This growing utilizations requires larger networks to achieve better performance. Increasing the size of a neural network typically improves accuracy but also increases the memory and computation requirements for training the model. The trade-off between the model accuracy and computational requirements is a crucial consideration in the design and optimization of neural networks. The training of deep neural network (DNN) also incurs high hardware computation costs. To address these issues, we propose adopting the Brain Floating Point (BFLOAT16) half-precision format. BFLOAT16 shares FP32's value range while requiring the same memory as FP16, simplifying conversion without hyper parameter tuning. It accelerates convergence while maintaining accuracy, as seen with Yolov2 Tiny model achieving 47.1 mAP, close to FP32's 47.2. The training time is also reduced to 17.6 Hours from 19.02 Hours taken by the FP32 model. The BFLOAT16 format offers a viable solution for cost-effective DNN training of larger neural networks while improving speed and reducing the hardware cost.

articleTitle: A Design of Kickback Noise Suppression Comparator for High-Speed Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes the design of a kickback noise suppression comparator for high-speed wireless communication. The technique used to suppress kickback noise from a latched-type dynamic comparator involves the use of switches to isolate the latch node from the input MOSFET. This technique is well-suited for high-speed wireless communication systems. The proposed comparator is implemented using the TSMC 180nm CMOS process and operates with a supply voltage of 1.8V. The results show that the proposed kickback noise suppression comparator exhibits a 75% reduction in comparison to conventional latched-type comparators.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis and Comparison of Knowledge Distillation Among Diverse Teacher and Student Models
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: With the advancements in deep learning, the development of large-scale models has become essential for many machine learning tasks in various fields such as computer vision and natural language. Such large-scale models demand extensive computational power and memory, posing challenges for practical deployment on mobile and edge devices. To address these issues, knowledge distillation, a technique for reproducing the performance of large-scale models with a smaller model, has been proposed. This paper investigates the effectiveness of knowledge distillation across various combinations of teach-student model pairs for image classification to deepen the understanding of knowledge distillation and the relationship between large- and small-scale models.

articleTitle: Brain Floating Point Precision for Object Detector
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: As the size of the deep neural network (DNN) model increases, the memory usage and computational time also increase. Deeper neural network models require huge memory size and high computational power. For edge devices, it is not feasible to run larger models with full precision. We present the usage of half precision data format which accelerates the computational time of DNN models and reduces the size of the final hardware while losing little accuracy.

articleTitle: Enhancing Plant and Disease Segmentation through Semi-Supervised Learning with Feature Distillation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes a network for plant and disease segmentation through semi-supervised learning in order to enhance agricultural production. Because of the hardness to get precisely labeled data, we use unlabeled data with pseudo labels. Furthermore, we employ a teacher-student network framework, where the teacher network imparts knowledge from labeled data to the student network. This boosts the segmentation precision of the student network, which is then exclusively trained on unlabeled data. We introduce a novel Exponential Moving Average (EMA) technique for teacher parameter updates, enhancing segmentation accuracy. Experimental results show that better segment performance can be achieved with the proposed network.

articleTitle: Accelerating YOLO-based Real-time Object Detection via Foveated Rendering
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Foveated rendering emulates human vision by prioritizing sharpness at the center while introducing peripheral blur outside this central area. We explore its potential for enhancing object detection performance by integrating it into various object detection methods. Our investigation demonstrates that foveated rendering effectively reduces detection time and false alarm detections, thus showcasing its utility in improving object detection performance. Experimental results indicate a reduction in detection time of up to 20% compared with object detection using conventional rendering techniques.

articleTitle: A Study on Acne Visualization and Prediction of Therapeutic Drug Effectiveness Using Wood's Lamp and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: A method to realize self-medication consumer electronics for the treatment of acne is proposed. Acne is visualized using a magnifying lens equipped with a special ultraviolet light called a Wood's lamp. This enables clear visualization of skin conditions that may not be visible to the naked eye, and many images are captured before and after the application of acne medication. Images before and after treatment are paired by aligning four pimples using mouse points. The pre- and post-treatment images are then subjected to deep learning using the pix2pix model. This process generates post-treatment images based on the pre-treatment images. Observing the condition of the acne and visualizing the post-treatment results can enhance motivation for treatment.

articleTitle: Implementation of a Tile-Grained Pipeline Architecture for CNN Accelerator
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a pipelined neural network accelerator circuit. The accelerator consists of two 256MACs PE arrays, operates at a frequency of 250MHz, and achieves a theoretical throughput of 256GOPS while utilizing relatively fewer FPGA resources. We implement the hardware on the Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+ MPSoC ZCU102 platform. Experimental results demonstrate that using this architecture can reduce DRAM access by nearly 40%.

articleTitle: Dual Encoding++ : Optimization of Text-Video Retrieval via Fine-tuning and Pruning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Video-text retrieval involves searching for related videos based on text queries and vice versa. While video-text retrieval models effectively retrieve information, they can be slow to train and computationally expensive. Our study applies optimization and compression techniques to an existing Dual Encoding model to address these issues. In the fine-tuning phase, various learning strategies are applied to enhance the model performance. Moreover, Architecture adjustments and network pruning are used to reduce complexity. The results of the experiments show improved performance with fewer parameters. The contributions of this study include a lightweight model with enhanced performance achieved through optimization and compression techniques. These findings suggest directions for future research on model enhancements in video-text retrieval. Re-implemented code can be found at https://github.com/dongYoun2/dual-encoding-system.

articleTitle: Exploring the Suitability of AVAS for Electric Scooters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Taiwan, which has the highest density of scooters in the world, has promoted the electrification of its scooter industry through policies, and electric scooters now account for more than 10% of the total scooter market. However, the nearly silent operation of electric scooters at low speeds has raised safety concerns. To address these safety concerns, the European Union and other countries, including Taiwan, have proposed regulations requiring the installation of noise devices on electric scooters. Considering the high density of scooters in Taiwan and its status as a key electric scooter manufacturing country, it is important to design appropriate warning sounds for electric scooters. This study aimed to explore the public's perception of the suitability and auditory perception of the acoustic vehicle alerting system (AVAS). The AVAS consists of three types of warning sounds: turn signal, slow-speed warning sound, and backup alarm sound. This investigation was conducted through a questionnaire survey and interviews. The results of this study show that the general public had a low level of recognition of the suitability of the existing AVAS for electric scooters. Moreover, the similarity between the sample sounds was high, resulting in a situation where the sounds were indistinguishable. The acoustic features of the electric scooter AVAS’s sounds directly affect the recognition and perception of the sounds. The results of this study are intended to provide guidance and suggestions to brands, designers, and researchers for the future design of electric scooter warning sounds.

articleTitle: Estimating the Infection Spread Rate of Malicious Botnets Using Reconnaissance Worms in Botnet Defense System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a method for estimating the infection spread rate of malicious botnets in Botnet Defense Systems (BDS), a cybersecurity system designed to eliminate malicious botnets. The proposed method involves moving white-hat worms along pre-defined routes rather than diffusing them randomly. This approach is expected to eliminate observation biases. However, this approach prevents the BDS from obtaining observation results until the worm passes through the unobserved area. Therefore, the route of the worm was carefully designed so that BDS could obtain early observations. Our simulation result shows that the proposed method can estimate the infection spread rate with more than 90% accuracy. The proposed method enables strategy planning according to the value of the infection spread rate and can contribute to the effective elimination of malicious botnets by BDS.

articleTitle: Hardware Accelerator for VSLAM using Fisheye Image in Embedded System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Visual Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (VSLAM) is a key technology for Autonomous Vehicles. Among them, the Indirect method of VSLAM is suitable for use in a vehicle environment where the surrounding situation changes quickly. However, it has the disadvantage of requiring additional resources to extract Feature Points. Separately, using Fisheye images for VSLAM can be utilized more effectively through a wide angle of view. However, the nature of Fisheye imagery introduces distortion, which requires additional resources to compensate for. These resource consumption is more critical in Embedded Systems such as vehicles. In addition, the execution time of VSLAM applied to Embedded Systems is too long to be used in the vehicle environment. In this paper, we propose a hardware accelerator for distortion correction of Fisheye images and feature point extraction of images. We use a Look-Up Table (LUT) for acceleration of distortion correction and simultaneously generate multiple scale images for Feature Point extraction. The Feature Points extractor is implemented by modified the SIFT algorithm, which has the best generalization performance. We applied it to CubemapSLAM, an Indirect VSLAM using Fisheye image. Experimental results show that the execution time of CubemapSLAM's tracking thread can be significantly reduced on embedded systems to about 5300 ms without hardware accelerator and 98.597 ms with hardware accelerator.

articleTitle: Unit-Cell Characterization for D-band Amplifier Design Using CMOS 40-nm technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: The paper discussed the feasibility of using CMOS for D-band wireless communication. We designed and measured an amplifier unit cell using the BULK CMOS 40-nm process. The unit cell achieved a gain of 1.21 dB at 145 GHz and a bandwidth of 36.4 GHz, with a power consumption of 3 mA at 1 V. This shows that CMOS can be used to achieve the desired performance and bandwidth for D-band wireless communication, while also being more cost-effective than compound semiconductor processes.

articleTitle: Efficient Load Balancing Method using Multi-Hop Network in Edge Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Load balancing in the edge computing has recently emerged as an important research topic due to manage the computing burden among edge nodes. However, there was no implementation and study at the hardware level yet. Rather system-level methodologies are studied. This paper aims to design and implement a multi-hop system for the efficient load balancing. Due to its multi-hop nature, this system can be applied to a variety of edge computing scenarios. To verify the effectiveness of the proposed load balancing system, we implemented FPGA based multi-hop system and compare the proposed load balancing system with conventional one. Validation results show that the communication success rate by the proposed method is higher up to 33%.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Model for Predicting Mortality in Heart Failure Patients Using Electronic Health Records and Exome Sequencing Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Heart failure is a cardiovascular disorder in which the heart’s contraction and relaxation do not function properly, resulting in an inadequate supply of the blood to the body. Despite advancements in medical technology, predicting the mortality of heart failure patients remains challenging as it is influenced by various factors such as the patient’s lifestyle, medical history or genetic traits. Recently, machine learning based on Electronic Health Record (EHR) data to predict the mortality of heart failure patients has been arising [1]. However, even though genetic data holds the potential to influence patient mortality, it remains difficult to find cases where genetic data has been used to predict patient outcomes due to the complexity of data understanding and processing. In our study, we trained a machine learning model to predict the mortality of heart failure patients and improved its performance by incorporating Whole Exome Sequence (WES) data.

articleTitle: A 43-fJ/Conv, 1-GS/s Energy-Efficient Charge-Steering Comparator with Floating-Inverter-Based Preamplifier in 40nm CMOS
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: This paper presents an energy efficient charge steering comparator with floating inverter-based preamplifier. The proposed comparator employs dynamic biasing operation in both the preamplifier and the comparator. This approach allows it to outperform the conventional strong-arm latch in terms of both energy efficiency and speed, making it particularly suitable for low-power applications. The architecture was designed, thoroughly simulated, and post-layout optimized using a 40nm CMOS technology. The proposed comparator achieves an energy efficiency of 43fJ per conversion with a supply voltage of 0.9V while operating at 1GHz.

articleTitle: The Effect of User Attributes on QoE of Transmission and Presentation Methods for Multi-View Video and Audio IP Transmission
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: This paper assumes a Multi-View Video and Audio (MVV-A) system with four cameras, i.e., the system has four viewpoints. We compare the Quality of Experience (QoE) of three video transmission and presentation methods: the one-view one-stream method, the one-view four-streams method, and the four-views four-streams method. We perform a subjective experiment with two types of users: male students who major in computer science and female students who major in teacher-training programs. As a result, we show that the user attributes can affect the trade-off related to the transmission and presentation methods of MVV-A.

articleTitle: Real-time motion classification with efficient event stream data processing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: In this paper, we introduce an effective technique for real-time motion classification using event cameras to process input data streams. Our method allows for real-time operation. To enhance memory efficiency, our approach reduces buffers in the event-to-frame conversion process, while simultaneously distributing frame conversion tasks to reduce processing time bottlenecks.

articleTitle: Device Location Recognition Using Channel State Information in Wireless LAN Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Location management of IoT devices is crucial for prompt incident response. In this paper, we propose an IoT device location monitoring system which utilizes Channel State Information (CSI) obtained in wireless LAN environments to recognize device locations. We conduct an experiment to verify whether device location recognition is possible using CSI data and machine learning. As a result, we confirm that using CSI allows for recognizing device locations with an accuracy of 99.4%, which is higher accuracy compared to using RSSI.

articleTitle: Optimizing Edge AI Solutions through Hardware and Software Co-Design
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: This paper introduces Edge AI solutions powered by DEEPX’s Neural Processing Units (NPUs): DX-L1, L2, and M1. Our work focuses on two aspects: (1) the specialized NPU technology to meet diverse applications and performance requirements; and (2) the DEEPX software development kit (DXNN), designed to streamline the optimization and deployment of AI models on NPUs. These solutions are crafted for a wide spectrum of computer vision applications, highlighting DEEPX’s system’s versatility and capability. Overall, this paper presents practical and integrated solutions that address the growing demands of Edge AI applications through hardware and software co-design.

articleTitle: Preprocessing at Application Nodes for Reduction of Data Transmission in Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Existing edge computing collects data from applications and transmits it to edge nodes. However, as the amount of data transmission increases, the network burden also increases. The goal of this paper is to reduce the amount of data transmission via preprocessing after collecting data in applications. Rather than simply transmitting whole data to the edge node, the data is preprocessed in application node, and only meaningful data is sent to the edge nodes. As a result, the amount of transmission data is reduced under low data quality loss.

articleTitle: Improved Design of Stand-by Circuit for Electric Vehicle Fast-charging Power Modules
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes an improved design of stand-by circuit (SC) for electric vehicle (EV) fast-charging power modules. The conventional SC has been designed by parallel power processing method. As a new design methodology, the proposed SC has adopted cascaded power processing method. Compared to the conventional SC, the proposed SC simplifies its circuit design and improves its power efficiency. Its operation principle and experiment verification have been discussed by testing the prototype system.

articleTitle: Low-Light Image Enhancement via Gradient Based Cross-Attention Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel deep learning-based method for enhancing low-light images. The approach introduces a transformer-based attention mechanism on gradient domain. Experimental results demonstrate superior performance compared to existing techniques, making it a promising solution for improving low-light image quality.

articleTitle: Advancing Temporal Spike Encoding for Efficient Speech Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Traditional artificial neural models have demonstrated considerable promise, but they frequently lack the intricate temporal dynamics inherent to biological neural systems. Standard models utilize continuous values for information transmission, whereas biological neurons communicate predominantly through discrete spike events. This study investigates the encoding of auditory data into spike sequences, with a particular focus on two techniques: Send on Delta (SOD) and SinSpike. Using these methods, speech signal was transformed into spiking representations, which were then evaluated in a series of experiments. As the link between external auditory stimuli and neural responses, the development of effective spike encoding techniques is crucial for advancing both our theoretical understanding and the practical applications of spiking neural networks in audio processing tasks. We show that efficient encoding methods yield improved speech recognition task compared to the use of a neuromorphic sensor.

articleTitle: PyEye: An Integrated Approach for Signal Integrity Assessment and Eye Diagram Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: This paper introduces a package tailored for eye diagram analysis of digital signals, a critical aspect of signal integrity evaluation. The package efficiently generates precise eye diagrams, quantifying signal integrity by identifying maximum area rectangles within the eye region. Using advanced algorithms and visualization techniques, the package equips professionals with a versatile tool for analysis, anomaly detection, and optimization. Experimental validation across diverse signals underscores the efficacy of the package, highlighting its potential for comprehensive signal integrity assessment.

articleTitle: Analysis Scheme for Energy Saving Effect Based on Gas AMI Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Gas AMI (Advanced Metering Infrastructure) is becoming widespread over household sectors. This infrastructure improves energy efficiency by utilizing various AMI information such as accumulated flow rate and number of households. Measuring an amount of energy saving is important to develop energy efficiency services. To this end, an analysis scheme for energy saving effect is required. Such analysis scheme should consider characteristics of energy usage data and external influence factors. In this paper, we propose an energy saving effect analysis scheme with gas AMI data. The proposed scheme determines baseline of energy usage M&V (Measurement and Verification). Suitable data for measuring energy savings are selected next through analysis methods of trend and correlation. To induce energy saving, a gas app provides energy usage information to users as feedback. The proposed scheme analyzes energy saving effect for whether the gas app is used or not.

articleTitle: Enhanced DV-Hop Algorithm using Graph Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Indoor positioning technology is one of the important applications of the Internet of Things. In order to reduce the localization error of DV-Hop algorithm in wireless sensor networks, an improved localization algorithm is proposed based on the study of graph theory algorithm. Weights are used on the basis of multi-hop accumulation. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm is feasible and effective. Compared with other algorithms, the positioning accuracy is improved by 25% ~ 30%. The study It can provide reference for monitoring spatial positioning in wireless sensor network.

articleTitle: Fault Type Classification of Rotating Machinery based on Machine Learning with Fourier Transform Feature Extraction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: This study presents an approach to classify failure types in rotating machinery using Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) for feature extraction and machine learning. Failures in rotating machinery can lead to substantial economic loss, and accurately classifying these failures is a complex task. The proposed method can contribute to enhancing the maintenance efficiency and system stability of rotating machinery. It can be applied across all industrial sectors involving rotating machinery. In this research, an FFT-based feature extraction method was implemented, transforming signals from the time domain to the frequency domain using window sizes corresponding to integer multiples of the machinery's rotation period. This process yielded significantly higher accuracy, up to 99.15%, compared to conventional deep learning methods when using window sizes corresponding to the rotation period. This represents a 21.96% improvement over existing deep learning techniques. The results demonstrate that feature extraction in the frequency domain using FFT is more effective than conventional time domain analysis.

articleTitle: UWB NLOS/LOS Classification Using Hybrid Quantum Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Ultra-wide-band (UWB) technology has emerged as a promising solution for providing accurate indoor positioning capabilities. However, indoor environments have various obstacles, which induce significant signal propagation effects. To avoid this issue, UWB signal classification is essential for improving positioning accuracy. This paper proposes a hybrid quantum convolutional neural network (HQCNN) inspired by convolutional neural networks for UWB none-line-of-sight/line-of-sight signal classification. The result shows that the HQCNN outperforms benchmarks.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison between OpenPose and TRT_Pose for Self-Practice Yoga on Embedded GPU Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: In order to enhance the performance of human pose estimation applications on embedded systems, accurately identifying human keypoints and interpreting pose-related information are crucial. In this study, two different pose estimation methods, namely "Openpose" and "TRT_pose", are applied, and their performances are compared by realizing on an embedded platform. The results obtained from these two pose estimation methods are evaluated by analyzing the positional differences of human joint keypoints with Euclidean distance. The study aims to provide insights into improving human pose estimation for embedded systems and facilitating the correct interpretation of human body poses. Additionally, a Yoga self-training system is utilized as the target, and Yoga movements are used as the comparison data.

articleTitle: A Flexible and Efficient Hardware Accelerator Architecture Design for Multiple CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: This paper presents a novel design for a neural network accelerator that supports multiple networks and incorporates various convolution operations, including Dilated convolution and Transposed convolution. To address the SRAM data read conflicts caused by the systolic execution of convolution operations, a Forwarding mechanism is introduced to mitigate these conflicts, and its effectiveness is demonstrated through the implementation of the Enet and Unet network. This work is of significant importance in improving the computational capabilities and expanding the application range of neural network accelerators.

articleTitle: A Novel Independent Monitoring Model for Efficient Out-of-Distribution Detection in CNNs: Utilizing The Forward-Forward Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Out-of-Distribution (OOD) detection is critical for identifying inputs incongruent with the trained classes of a model. Incorrect classifications, notably in sectors like healthcare, autonomous driving, and industrial inspection, can be catastrophic. Addressing this, our paper introduces a new method for OOD detection essential in these fields. Our approach employs a standalone monitoring model, not connected by weights to the image classification model, thus avoiding retraining needs. The Forward-Forward (FF) Algorithm helps in understanding the connection between the final feature maps of the classification model and its results, leading to a Positive or Negative classification. This strategy enhances OOD detection efficiency and integrates well with existing deep learning models.

articleTitle: Discriminative Learning for Supervised Anomaly Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Most unsupervised anomaly detection methods learn distributions from normal samples, which solve the class-imbalance problem with different amounts of samples. However, learning only normal samples can affect the model to have loose decision boundary and low discriminality. In this paper, we propose the novel supervised approach for detecting anomalies by exploiting known anomaly samples. Our method uses embeddings from ImageNet backbone model and transfer extracted features towards target domain using feature adaptor. Then, anomaly score is computed using GAN discriminator, which differentiates positive and negative samples to estimate normality of an image. Our approach achieves an anomaly detection AUROC of 99.2% on MVTec AD benchmark.

articleTitle: 0.18um 1P6M CMOS Virtual View Generator Based on DIBR Technology for 3D Display
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: In this paper, we proposed 0.18um 1P6M CMOS virtual view generator based on DIBR technology for 3D display. This paper aims to improve the image quality and allow users to have better stereoscopic vision. The depth map will be pre-processed to reduce the less accurate part of the object edge in the depth map, and the part of the larger hole will be re-cut into a small hole with a pixel width by parallax adjustment. Finally, we propose the proximity filling method to fill in the holes in the virtual perspective. We use 0.18um CMOS technology to design 3D display chips, and the experimental results confirm that our circuits can achieve high-quality 3D image display and real time processing.

articleTitle: Context-aware Image-to-Image Translation for Autonomous Driving
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: The fusion of deep learning and autonomous driving presents challenges in computer vision, particularly in image-to-image translation to simulate real driving conditions. A notable constraint in the industry is the scarcity of diverse, realistic training data, hindering progress in capturing fine-grained details like weather changes. To address this, extensive research has explored deep learning-based image-to-image translation. Our work targets a critical issue within autonomous driving datasets: the loss of important objects in image translation. We introduce context-aware image-to-image translation (CAIT), embedding image context information by utilizing features from a pre-trained segmentation map prediction network.

articleTitle: Radar Target Detection Method through Spatial Voxelization in Complex Indoor Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: This paper is about a method for extracting the target point of a signal received from a radar sensor through spatial voxelization in an indoor environment with many metal objects such as partitions, PCs, and monitors. Radar sensors are widely used in autonomous driving, sensor data convergence, etc., and various methods have been studied to find the reference point of the radar sensor. The conventional method was to measure a signal in a calibration room without any objects or to find a reference point using a plurality of corner reflectors. However, we propose a method of voxelizing a space with a single corner reflector in a complex environment and extracting an accurate target point with only a specific range of RCS(Radar Cross Section) values. The validity of the proposed algorithm was verified through experiments and analysis in various locations, and it was confirmed that it was effective.

articleTitle: Camera Position Comparison System of Free-viewpoint Data Acquisition Equipment Using Dissimilar Sensors for 3D Data Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: We aim to research to acquire precise data of camera for generating 3D data more convenient than exist devices in cultural heritage field. The camera position is one of fundamental factors to construct 3D data, so the study has been required to compare the camera position data from various type of sensors in the same coordinate system. The correlations between different sensors are analysed and transferred to each coordinate system for comparing camera positions. The outcome represents that camera positions from T265 sensor and OptiTrack system are more stable than the data from COLMAP, which can be influenced on the texture of objects and data acquiring environment. Future work will be focus on the improvement of the 3D data quality by the change of camera positions from dissimilar sensors.

articleTitle: A Deep Multi-Object Tracking Technique in Swimming Video Scenes
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: There are many kinds of objects for multi-object tracking, but among them, tracking attempts for swimmers can be challenging. There are several factors that cause difficulties, and due to the nature of the swimming competition video, overhead race video, swimmer is covered by water and spectators, occlusion occurs, and a rapid change of direction or occlusion occurs to lose an object. Another special issue of swimmer tracking is the spray of water generated by swimming, which makes it difficult to extract the feature. In order to track the swimming data set with these characteristics, this paper divided and analyzed the swimming competition scene according to the ease of tracking, and proposed a hyper-parameter for kinds of features extracted in the FairMOT, which is one of multi-object tracking algorithms, to improve the performance of swimmer tracking.

articleTitle: Comparison of Leak Detection Techniques Using Water Pipeline Vibration Sensor Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: This paper conducts a comparative study on leak detection techniques using vibration sensor data installed in water pipeline networks. By applying machine learning techniques, we have implemented a technology to detect and classify leaks in water pipelines, thereby enabling the prediction of leaks in the water mains. The vibration sensor dataset used in this study consists of leak detection sensor data installed in water supply meters and valve chambers within the water supply network. This dataset includes data provided by the public data portal (AI hub) as well as investigation data provided by a company. The investigation data were collected in the field by leakage detection experts. We designed leak classification models using various machine learning techniques and measured and analyzed the performance of each dataset using feature importance.

articleTitle: Congestion Monitoring and Exposure of 5G Network for XR service
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: XR services are being gradually introduced and it is expected to be a significant application in the future. XR service is a kind of time critical service and network performance fluctuation may degrade user experience. This paper discusses congestion monitoring and exposure of 5G network for fast codec/rate adaptation of XR service. We employ Explicit Congestion Notification (ECN) in 5G network. Our proposal is direct echo back of congestion information to the sender instead of waiting until ECN mark reaches to the receiver and the receiver echoes congestion information back to the sender. This direct echo back will enable fast adaptation of codec/rate in XR server.

articleTitle: Model Comparison Study for Microscopic Symptom Classification of Plant Diseases
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: This study is an important component of an innovative project that integrates agriculture with artificial intelligence, aimed at detecting difficult diseases that are challenging for humans to identify. Leveraging the power of artificial intelligence, our work focuses on pinpointing imperceptible diseases. The performance of the classification model depends on the informativeness of the feature map. Therefore, we compare various models specialized for this purpose. Given the characteristics of plant diseases, many complexities make it challenging to distinguish between different illnesses. In this study, we reaffirm the exceptional performance of the Residual Attention Network (RAN) consisting of residual blocks and attention modules. We have previously reviewed a paper on the combined Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) of residuals and attention, which has proven advantageous in exploring the inherent complexities of these challenges. The primary goal of our study is to utilize artificial intelligence to identify the best-performing disease classification model. When the classification problem was executed with RAN, significant improvements in all indicators were achieved.

articleTitle: Stereo Confidence Estimation with Pyramid Pooling Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: We present a transformer-based encoder-decoder structure for estimating confidence map in stereo matching. Confidence map is obtained by estimating the reliability of the estimated disparity by stereo matching. Recently, deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have improved stereo estimation performance. However, these approaches have weakness with global feature. To address this limitation, we propose a novel stereo estimation method using transformer network to effectively capture the global information. Additionally, we introduce a Pyramid Pooling network to capture the local information as well as CNN structure. Experimental results show that the proposed architecture effectively capture both global and local information.

articleTitle: Contour-aware anomaly detection system for autoencoder neural network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Autoencoder (AE) networks are one of the widely used techniques that effectively detect anomalies in the images/videos from the variation of reconstruction errors between the input and output images. However, reconstruction errors are sensitive to various noises, making the model inference unstable and leading to inaccurate localization of an abnormal region in the input image. To alleviate this problem, this paper presents a post-processing algorithm to classify anomaly events by localizing anomalous contour areas from the residual image of the autoencoder neural network. Furthermore, the proposed post-processing algorithm can be integrated into the training process of autoencoder network as the validation step. It, therefore, automates both the training process of the autoencoder network and hyperparameters tuning of the proposed post-processing system. Preliminary experiments on embedded devices show improved performance in simulated environments with repetitive operations involving a robot arm and conveyor belt.

articleTitle: Attention-Temporal Convolutional Networks for EEG-based Emotion Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Emotion recognition is an emerging technology that employs various types of data modalities to detect and interpret human emotional states. Among them, electroencephalogram (EEG) has gained attention for its ability to capture underlying emotions related to specific brain activities. In this study, we adopt the attention-temporal convolutional network (ATCNet), previously recognized for its efficacy in decoding motor imagery EEG data, to develop a high-performance emotion recognition method. Our modified ATCNet achieved an average accuracy of 95.71% using the SEED dataset, which has three emotional classes, including positive, negative, and neutral.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Hardware Implementation of Handwritten Digit Inference using Arduino and Ternary Output Binary Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: In this paper, we analyze binary neural network (BNN) and ternary output BNN (ToBNN) from a software perspective, and introduce tiny machine learning (TinyML) hardware implementation of handwritten digit inference. Both BNN and ToBNN achieve a reduction of approximately 70% in memory usage for weight storage by using binary values. Inference energy consumption was also reduced by approximately 32%. ToBNN achieves 90.24% inference accuracy for MNIST dataset, while conventional BNN shows 50.25% accuracy. To implement TinyML hardware, Arduino Uno, Portenta H7, TFT touch LCD shield, and 16×2 LCD were used. The hardware implementation results show successful inference for handwritten digits.

articleTitle: A Method for Constructing Collision Avoidance Route for Multiple UAVs Using AODV-Based Link Hierarchization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) route constructing methods have been researched using protocols for ad hoc networks composed by smart meter radio devices. In the previous study, we established the method which construct the most optimal route for UAV travel in terms of travel distance and safety based on AODV. Every node was given information whether it was in a densely populated area or scattered residential area. In this research, to eliminate the risk of UAVs collision due to overlapping routes of multiple UAVs navigating simultaneously, we propose a method of locking links so that the link used for a UAV constructing route cannot be used for the route of other UAVs. In addition, we propose link hierarchization in the air to solve the link shortage caused by locking links. We evaluate and verify the effectiveness and characteristics of the proposed methods by computer simulation.

articleTitle: A Modeling and Simulation of ReRAM with Nonidealities for System-Level PIM Validation in System Verilog
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: This paper presents an efficient modeling approach of resistive random-access memory (ReRAM) for fast system-level validation of ReRAM-based processing-in-memory (PIM). The proposed of ReRAM model is implemented with XMODEL primitives in SystemVerilog, providing compatibility with Verilog models of PIM architecture. Various nonidealities of ReRAM are realized in the proposed model such as resistance states, switching voltages, and dynamic current fluctuation. Hence, ReRAM-based PIMs can be modeled and validated in more accurate and efficient way with the proposed ReRAM model. Compared with previous Verilog-A modeling approaches, the proposed modeling achieves about 95% simulation time reduction in 64 ReRAM cell array.

articleTitle: Relationship between AND extension and XOR extension of 3-valued input with 2-party card-based protocols
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: The matching situation with AND operations between two parties is a common application in card-based protocols, and it is known to provide a non-embarrassing confession of love. This means that the other party does not know whether the input was 0 or 1, which is said to avoid embarrassment. Extended AND protocols that extend the normal AND operation with two input choices of 0, 1 to allow a third "indeterminate" value that is neither 0 nor 1 have been proposed in ICCE-TW2022. Similar extensions to the XOR operation were also proposed at ICCE-TW2023, each of which is given commutative semigroup classifications.By finding algebraic isomorphism in the commutative semi-groups of AND and XOR extensions discussed above, this paper presents two examples of compatible implementations of the card-based protocols. We also show that it is possible to construct card protocols with different boolean tables by changing only the encoding rules while keeping the same procedures exactly.

articleTitle: Implementation of GUI-based SOME/IP and SOME/IP-SD communication
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: This research paper introduces a graphical user interface (GUI)-based communication program designed for scalable service-oriented middleware over IP (SOME/IP) packet communication. The program establishes an environment for generating, transmitting, and monitoring both SOME/IP and SOME/IP service discovery (SOME/IP-SD) packets. This paper offers a concise overview of the GUI-oriented SOME/IP communication program, accompanied by an analysis of both transmitted and received packets using Wireshark. Additionally, potential avenues for future research are also discussed.

articleTitle: Advanced Color Pseudo Anomaly to Enhance Learning of Convolutional Neural Network Models
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Advanced Vision Inspection Systems (VIS) enable automation of anomaly detection in the production lines of smart factories. Incorporating a pseudo-anomaly insertion step in the training process allows a target VIS to effectively differentiate normal and abnormal examples for specific product. However, prior research has not extensively explored the fundamental nature of abnormalities in the process of product defect detection. In this work, we introduce a novel Color Anomaly Insertion (CAI) scheme that adds anomalies into specific images considering color of anomaly as a key attribute. CAI transforms the color of anomalies into dark/bright and challenging forms. Overall anomaly insertion in CAI is done in two steps: first, anomaly patterns are extracted, and then their colors are transformed into desired color by altering RGB channels.

articleTitle: A Study on the Implementation of User Web/APP Based Reading Ability Assessment Service
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: This paper presents the implementation results of an web/app-based service framework for evaluating fluency and comprehension through the recognition of speech voices of Korean elementary school students. User speech recognition applies a pre-trained model based on the koSpeech library to convert user speech into text, and evaluates text reading ability through CER measurement. Additionally, over a certain period of time, the speech uttered by the user is collected, transformed into text, and comprehension ability is assessed through semantic textual similarity measurement.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Frame Merging Methods on Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN)
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Modern vehicles are incorporating a wide array of technologies, leading to a substantial increase in data requirements. Concurrently, as vehicles integrate more Electronic Control Units (ECUs), there is a shift in their network architecture. Time Sensitive Networking (TSN) based on Ethernet is emerging as a key area of research to tackle these challenges. In this paper, we introduce both a region-based merge method and a period-based merge method. These approaches aim to reduce the overhead associated with Ethernet frame headers when transitioning CAN frames to Ethernet frames. This is especially pertinent for transmissions from the lower node of the End System (ES) to the upper Switch (SW). Moreover, our methods can efficiently manage the unavoidable delay time. The results and performance for each method is included.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Reduce A Visual Gap Using Inpainting GAN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Image blending represents a technique employed in image composition, aimed at creating a composite image that appears as natural and realistic as possible. The objective of image blending is to ensure that the transitions between objects in the image appear seamless and without any color distortion. Recently, numerous studies investigated image blending methods adopting deep learning-based image processing algorithms and contributed to generating natural blended images. Although the previous studies show remarkable performance in many cases, they suffer from quality drop when blending incompletely cropped object. This paper introduces a novel approach that effectively reduces the unnatural edges and the color distortion in such cases. In this study, an algorithm which called edge checking (EC) is proposed to identify and manage incompletely cropped regions. To address missing or masked parts of the object image and integrate them into the image blending process, an inpainting generative adversarial model are employed.

articleTitle: Implementation of Activation functions using inverse delta coding LUT
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Activation functions are essential components of deep neural networks (DNNs). However, the use of exponential functions and dividers for non-linearity significantly increases hardware costs. This article presents a hardware architecture for activation functions that uses inverse delta coding LUT. We implemented an inverse LUT approach by utilizing the fact that the output range is smaller than the input range. Additionally, to lower the bit-depth of LUT components, delta coding was applied, resulting in a 64.45% reduction in the size of the lookup table compared to full size LUT, with no significant decrease in accuracy.

articleTitle: Exploring the effects of vibratile takeover request in autonomous driving across various locations
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: The effects of vibratile takeover request is explored by comparing across vibratile alert locations <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>: (1) seat back (2) seat pan (3) seat belt (4) wristband. In order to assess the effects, the parameters are: (i) crash count (ii) reaction time (iii) physical comfort (iv) mental workload. To simulate non-driving-related-tasks on experiment, participants were requested to watch their favorite video. By engaging in an enjoyable activity, participants were expected to be engaged and occupied, enabling monitor participants’ mental workload and level of distress in a more naturalistic setting. The potential for a state of discomfort to enhance a response triggered by surprise is apparent, as higher levels of comfort or discomfort are correlated with faster reaction times. Conversely, more subtle levels of comfort and discomfort are associated with comparatively slower responses. This proposes that a state of discomfort could play a role in eliciting an unforeseen reaction, potentially enhancing the driver’s readiness for responding to takeover requests.

articleTitle: Dynamic Compressive Sensing Matrix for Electrocardiogram Signal Projection in Healthcare IoT Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Compressive Sensing (CS) is a signal processing technique used to trim the amount of signal required without losing important information in a signal. In this research, we construct the sensing matrix Φ dynamically based on the observed ECG signal. The proposed method resulted in significantly better Signal-to-Noise-Ratio and Processing Time compared with other sensing matrix Φ. The calculation results are presented in this paper along with the test scenarios and images of the observed signal reconstruction results based on the number of samples and the measurement rate determined.

articleTitle: Concept Design of Intelligent BoP Based on Slot-/Rack-type Fuel Cell for Integrated Management of Hydrogen Fuel Cells
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics-Asia (ICCE-Asia)
abstract: Due to the global warming problem, the importance of eco-friendly fuels that do not emit environmental pollutants is increasing as a substitute for existing energy sources. Hydrogen, an ecofriendly fuel, is an eco-friendly fuel with high energy density to weight and no emission of environmental pollutants, and its importance as a substitute for existing energy sources is increasing. In particular, hydrogen fuel cells can supply energy stably for a long time due to their high energy conversion efficiency, and water and heat produced as by-products can be used in other areas such as smart farms, so they have high added value other than electricity production. A hydrogen fuel cell consists of a fuel cell stack and BoP (Balance of Plant). A fuel cell stack is a device that produces electricity and heat by reacting hydrogen and oxygen.
